UNKNOWN: Re-run the tool with verbose/debug flags to capture full output.
Verify the tool is installed and accessible in the current SIFT environment.
Confirm the target artefact path exists and is readable (check permissions).
Check whether the image or volume was correctly mounted before invocation.
SUSPECTED: Review the full stderr for the root cause of partial output.
Cross-validate this finding with a second tool targeting the same artefact.
Determine if the artefact is corrupt, encrypted, or unsupported by this tool version.
Check tool version compatibility with the evidence image format.
INFERRED: Correlate hashes / offsets with known-good reference databases (e.g. NSRL).
Chain this output with timeline analysis to establish causal ordering.
Acquire additional artefacts (memory dump, network pcap) to confirm interpretation.
Run a complementary tool to corroborate this interpretation.
